prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original static settlement-town pixel-art sprite for the dark-fantasy strategy game Theandril, replacing a rejected underdeveloped town design.
Background: GENUINE TRANSPARENT PNG alpha-zero outside the isolated settlement. No painted checkerboard, floor tile, scenery, text, captions, border, or watermark.
Style: deliberate coarse square pixel clusters readable at 96x96 logical pixels, enlarged on the source canvas. Restrained upper-left light, selective dark outline, strong roof/masonry midtone planes. No gradients, bloom, antialiasing, blur, painterly microtexture or speckled confetti.
Composition: shallow southeast three-quarter/isometric view. One coherent LOW, BROAD town enclosure, dense 7–9 buildings clustered tightly around a substantial central market hall. The town itself occupies a broad near-square silhouette, about 70% of canvas width and 60–65% of height, with at least 15% genuinely transparent empty margin on all four sides. All pixels contained. Most of the silhouette is usable building mass, NOT empty ground.
Development: unequivocally MORE developed than a simple three-house village: numerous connected two-storey workhouses, a large low market hall, short enclosing walls and a modest gate. Still NOT a grand capital/city: no towering keep, large cathedral, tall corner towers or palace.
CRITICAL: NO flags, banners, poles, needles, spires or high narrow towers above the roofline. No high feature consuming native sprite height. No detached satellite buildings. Keep clear low broad roof masses and building count legible. No people.
Culture: Saltwind Remnant, successor charter fleets rather than a restored Saltwind League. Weathered tar-dark timber, muted PETROL walls and AUBURN sailcloth roofs, brass rigging accents. A tightly connected, broad stilt-quay town of eight substantial trade/work buildings enclosing a low central covered market hall, short sturdy plank palisades, thick mooring piles and a compact quay frontage. Angular triangular auburn roofs with broad clear planes. No Glass Tide blue sails, round glass, magical glow, or water background. At 96px the dark timber structure must retain readable medium-value auburn/petrol roof planes.

licenseNotes: Original built-in image generation commissioned for Theandril. Service terms apply; no model or provider rights independently inferred. Seed/model unavailability is recorded explicitly in retained source metadata.
